description: Starts WOZ lookups for a whole list of Dutch addresses, for example from a spreadsheet the user shared. Runs a free trial on 5 addresses, then gives the price of the full list and a payment page for the user. Returns a list_token for get_address_list. Sending the same list again within an hour returns the same list.

addresses.description: The addresses, one string per row in the original order, each with house number and postcode or city.

email.description: Optional. The user's own e-mail address for delivery of the file and the invoice, only if the user typed it.

place.description: Optional. The city for all addresses that have no postcode or city.

trial_code.description: The trial_code from start_trial. Leave empty when the user is signed in to WozApi or the connection has a WozApi API key.

name: start_address_list
title: Adreslijst starten
